name: TMS OS Platform V14.0.3 — SQLite Support & MariaDB Deep-Clean
notes: Adds SQLite as a lightweight database alternative to MariaDB (no daemon, no root, cannot fail installation). The installer now asks which database mode to use (SQLite recommended by default). MariaDB mode performs a thorough deep-clean of old data/sockets/pid/config before reinstalling, with automatic data directory reinitialization and --user= fallback.
features: SQLite database mode: lightweight, no daemon, perfect for old/weak devices
Database mode selector during installation (press Enter for SQLite default)
MariaDB deep-clean: removes stale data directories, sockets, pid files and configs before reinstalling
Automatic MariaDB data directory reinitialization if damaged (mariadb-install-db)
mariadbd-safe --user= fallback when the default mysql user cannot write pid files
Unified service manager hides MariaDB automatically in SQLite mode
Guardian, diagnostics, repair and service scripts respect the chosen DB mode
Robust Android/Termux LAN IPv4 discovery with multiple fallbacks
Never publishes 127.0.0.1 as a LAN address
Short direct LAN URL using Wi-Fi IP and each website port
Optional short .lan name through downloadable hosts file
sslip.io retained only as an optional advanced URL when a valid LAN IP exists
Unified Core V13.0 service and queue architecture retained
